attacks.summary: Russian UAV attacks affected multiple Kyiv districts on 23 September. By late afternoon, city authorities reported two people killed and 43 injured citywide.

sources.note: Official rolling city update on the 23 September attack and district-level consequences.
Rolling report citing city authorities; late-afternoon update reports two killed and 43 injured citywide.

attacks.summary: Russian UAV attacks caused injuries and damage in Buchanskyi, Obukhivskyi, Fastivskyi and Vyshhorodskyi raions. Three people were injured in Buchanskyi raion and 18 objects were reported damaged across the four raions.

sources.note: Cites Kyiv Oblast administration; reports three injured and 18 damaged objects across four raions.
Corroborates Kyiv Oblast administration figures and district-level damage.

incidents.summary: UAV impacts damaged a transport-related site and a fuel station in Darnytskyi district. At least one person was initially reported injured in the district.

damage.description: A transport-related site and a fuel station were reported damaged.

en.summary: UAV impacts damaged a transport-related site and a fuel station in Darnytskyi district. At least one person was initially reported injured in the district.

damage.description: A transport-related site and a fuel station were reported damaged.

uk.summary: У Дарницькому районі внаслідок влучань БпЛА пошкоджено об’єкт транспортної інфраструктури та АЗС. Спочатку повідомлялося щонайменше про одного постраждалого в районі.

damage.description: Повідомлялося про пошкодження об’єкта транспортної інфраструктури та АЗС.

incidents.summary: UAV impacts damaged a fuel station and warehouse premises in Holosiivskyi district.

damage.description: A fuel station and warehouse premises were reported damaged.

en.summary: UAV impacts damaged a fuel station and warehouse premises in Holosiivskyi district.

damage.description: A fuel station and warehouse premises were reported damaged.

uk.summary: У Голосіївському районі внаслідок влучань БпЛА пошкоджено АЗС і складські приміщення.

damage.description: Повідомлялося про пошкодження АЗС і складських приміщень.

incidents.summary: UAV debris fell at multiple locations in Solomianskyi district and a fire occurred on the territory of a transport enterprise.

damage.description: A fire was reported on the territory of a transport enterprise.

en.summary: UAV debris fell at multiple locations in Solomianskyi district and a fire occurred on the territory of a transport enterprise.

damage.description: A fire was reported on the territory of a transport enterprise.

uk.summary: У Солом’янському районі уламки БпЛА впали у кількох місцях, а на території транспортного підприємства виникла пожежа.

damage.description: На території транспортного підприємства повідомлялося про пожежу.

incidents.summary: Three men were injured in Buchanskyi raion. Fourteen objects were damaged, including six private homes, warehouse and administrative premises, a communal-enterprise site, an infrastructure object and two cars.

damage.description: Damage included six private homes, warehouse and administrative premises, a communal-enterprise site, an infrastructure object and two cars.

en.summary: Three men were injured in Buchanskyi raion. Fourteen objects were damaged, including six private homes, warehouse and administrative premises, a communal-enterprise site, an infrastructure object and two cars.

damage.description: Damage included six private homes, warehouse and administrative premises, a communal-enterprise site, an infrastructure object and two cars.

uk.summary: У Бучанському районі травмувалися троє чоловіків. Пошкоджено 14 об’єктів, зокрема шість приватних будинків, складські й адміністративні приміщення, територію комунального підприємства, об’єкт інфраструктури та два автомобілі.

damage.description: Пошкоджено шість приватних будинків, складські й адміністративні приміщення, територію комунального підприємства, об’єкт інфраструктури та два автомобілі.

incidents.summary: Two private homes were damaged in Obukhivskyi raion.

damage.description: Two private homes were damaged.

en.summary: Two private homes were damaged in Obukhivskyi raion.

damage.description: Two private homes were damaged.

uk.summary: В Обухівському районі пошкоджено два приватні будинки.

damage.description: Пошкоджено два приватні будинки.

incidents.summary: A production building was damaged in Fastivskyi raion.

uk.summary: У Фастівському районі пошкоджено виробниче приміщення.

incidents.summary: An infrastructure object was reported damaged in Vyshhorodskyi raion. The public record retains only raion-level location detail.

uk.summary: У Вишгородському районі повідомлялося про пошкодження об’єкта інфраструктури. У публічному записі збережено лише рівень району.

damage.description: Повідомлялося про пошкодження об’єкта інфраструктури; чутливі деталі місця не публікуються.
